_README: Controlled vocabulary for beauty-librarian. CLOSED facets: the skill must pick only from the listed values (no inventing). OPEN facets: the skill may propose a NEW normalized value when nothing fits, but must flag it for monthly review. Add new words here to teach the skill — edits take effect with no code change. Keep values lowercase-hyphenated.

notes.accessory_none: Use 'none' to mean the style needs no accessory at all — makes 'just my hands' filterable.
notes.tool_none: 'no-heat' and 'no-tools' are explicit so absence-of-heat is filterable.
notes.suitable-for: Describes what a style can TOLERATE (e.g. worn UNDER a hat/helmet), not what's worn as the look. For hairstyle/hijab, assess it (hat-friendly etc., or 'none' if it doesn't hold up). For makeup, default to 'not-applicable'. Multi-value allowed.
notes.accessibility_none: Apply 'none' when no accommodation tag fits, so the facet is always present.
notes.state_bare-face: For makeup, 'bare-face' marks the starting point.
